caseName: Widner v. Crosby, Secretary, Florida Department of Corrections
caseNameFull: Widner v. Crosby, Secretary, Florida Department of Corrections

opinions.text: C. A. 11th Cir. Motion of petitioner for leave to proceed in forma pauperis granted. Certio-rari granted, judgment vacated, and case remanded for further consideration in light of Carey v. Saffold, 536 U. S 214 (2002).
